page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture with dedicated CPU allocation. The instance configuration provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 35 MB of L3 cache, alongside instruction set support for AVX-512F and AES. Memory capacity is configured at 32.0 GB, providing a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is not included, and the network interface provides a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Dedicated hardware accelerators such as GPUs are not present.

Benchmark evaluations reveal a notable distinction between single-thread efficiency and aggregate multi-core throughput. Single-threaded metrics are comparatively weak, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 929.0 and bottom-decile compression speeds. Conversely, parallel execution scales effectively across all 16 vCPUs, yielding mid-tier results in PassMark CPU (13258.46), Geekbench multi-core (5695.0), and Clang compilation tasks. Memory bandwidth is stable for uncached transfers, achieving 77.43 GB/sec for reads and 59.68 GB/sec for writes, which translates into 11.29 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.65 GB/sec of static web serving throughput.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio offers density for compute tasks that do not require expansive memory footprints, providing qualitative resource efficiency for parallelized processing. However, the lack of bundled local NVMe storage and moderate per-core performance require external network-attached volumes and make the instance less suitable for latency-sensitive, single-threaded applications. The instance is suited for multi-threaded compilation pipelines, distributed worker nodes, continuous integration systems, and general web tier serving.
